criteria.requirement: Add liquid.record_rendering.render_records and async-generator render_records_async over lazy (id,Mapping) records, returning immutable RenderedRecord(id,status,output,error-type). Use real BoundTemplate.render/render_async each time so assigns/cycle state does not leak across records. Preserve input order and identity; reject duplicate ids; continue mode records LiquidError without data/error-message leakage, fail-fast rethrows. Ordinary user exceptions and cancellation propagate. Keep work strictly pull-driven with no prefetch/unbounded tasks; closing after one item never executes later records. Both APIs are serial by explicit contract, no concurrency claim.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
